notes.title: Update notes for V 0.2.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863297/77afec9ae4663fe47ba7719464208a226ad245b5.jpg[/img]
[b]FEATURES + UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] INVENTORY BUG CAUSES ITEMS TO OCCASIONALLY BE DELETED ON PICKUP [THIS IS A GAME BREAKING PROGRESS BUG, FIXED]

[*] SHOVEL TOOL SEEMS TO RANDOMLY CLEAR THE SNOW PILES. [AGAIN THIS IS A GAME BREAK PROGRESS BUG, FIXED]

[*] CONSUMABLE ANIMATIONS FEATURE [DRINK/CANNED FOOD/BANDAGE] CONSUMES/LOCKS SLOT BUG. [THIS BUGS OUT THE INVENTORY. BUT IS NOT A GAME BREAKING BUG. FIXED]

[*] PLACABLES ITEM PARTS [BATTERY, TENT, FIRE CAMP, OUTBOARD MOTOR, ETC.] SLOT DOES NOT CLEAR AFTER PLACEMENT. [NOT A GAME BREAKING BUG. FIXED]

[*] Various playtesters feedback addressing many bugs,suggestions, and fixes.
[/list]

NEXT UPDATE WILL IMPLEMENT A SAVE SYSTEM! HOPEFULLY BEFORE THE BETA ENDS.

Hope everyone enjoys the more polished version of Resort Strip. Most major bugs are out of the way thanks to all play testers help and support feedback. Couldn't do it without you, so I Thank you :D
I will make sure everyone is in the credits.

notes.title: Update notes for V 0.2.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863297/77afec9ae4663fe47ba7719464208a226ad245b5.jpg[/img]
[b]FEATURES + UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] INVENTORY BUGS SHOULD BE FIXED NOW!
[*] SNOW SHOVEL BUGS SHOULD BE FIXED NOW!
[*] VARIOUS IMPROVEMENTS IN BACK ROUND AND ADDED MANY FAN SUGGESTIONS.

[*] FOV Option
[*] Crouch Key bind Option
[*] FOV Option
[*] Arrow Keys now control movement for left hand players
[*] Beanie/Toque has been visually changed to offer more screen space. [many users complained about this one. thank you for your feedback.]
[*] Level2 Start Items have been added to your inventory.
[*] Footsteps Code has been ravamped. [prepared for coming individual material differences]
[*] Hypothermia Text Corrected
[*] Fires fixed to not burn infinitely
[*] Pistol Aim has been corrected to original expectations [good bye to my unique gun hold aim lol]
[*] Collision Issues with Weapon bullets prevent bullets form killing A.I
[*] All Animals should now have self shadows making them look properly grounded
[*] Infected Animals now spawn Blood on damage
[*] Increased Infected Body remove from game timer. [10 sec to 30 secs]
[/list]

Do let us know if any problems still persist. Otherwise, back to work on the new Pristine Lake Map.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863297/77afec9ae4663fe47ba7719464208a226ad245b5.jpg[/img]
[b]KNOWN PROBLEMS[/b]

[list]
[*] INVENTORY BUG - REMOVES OR DELETES ITEMS PICKED UP. [RARE] This Bug causes items to be removed after a pickup. We are narrowing down the problem and have temporarily attempted to fixed it. Lets us know if the problem still persists.

[*] NO SAVE SYSTEM. The save system will be added later. Please be patient with us.

[*] NO GROUP AUDIO OPTIONS. This will be added shortly.
[/list]

[b]FEATURES + UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] Revamped Level1 'Snow Storm' Map. Vehicle is now pushed back to entry of map location for a more linear experience.

[*]Inventory adjustments to help with Inventory bug. [Removed Auto Pickup Equips]

[*]Various improvements to levels.
[/list]
